summary.text: Ask a CHAS clinic or polyclinic for a referral to subsidised care at public SOCs.

steps.name: Ask for a referral
steps.text: To get subsidised care at public SOCs, ask a CHAS clinic or polyclinic for a referral. You must be a PG/MG/CHAS cardholder to get a subsidised SOC referral from a CHAS clinic.

points.lead: You can get a referral from:
items: A CHAS clinic, if you are a PG/MG/CHAS cardholder.

example_phrasings: How can I get a referral for subsidised care at public SOCs?
How do I get subsidised SOC care?
Can a polyclinic refer me for subsidised care?

sources.page_title: How can I get a referral for subsidised care at public SOCs?

quotes.text: A referral for subsidised care at public SOCs can be obtained from either CHAS clinics or polyclinics.

A referral for subsidised care at public SOCs can be obtained from either CHAS clinics or polyclinics. Do note that you will need to be a PG/MG/CHAS cardholder to obtain subsidised SOC referrals from CHAS clinics.
